name: dns-checker
description: Check live DNS records and email authentication (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX) for a domain.

interface.longDescription:
Check a domain's live DNS records and email authentication with an email DNS check that queries public resolvers through DNS-over-HTTPS for MX, SPF, DMARC, and DKIM, then returns a pass/warn/fail findings list and a CSV report.

SPF is parsed into its mechanisms and the DNS lookups are counted against the RFC 7208 limit of 10, so an include chain that is too deep is flagged before receivers reject the mail. DMARC is read for the policy, the subdomain policy, the percentage, the aggregate and forensic reporting addresses, and the DKIM and SPF alignment. DKIM keys are looked up for the selectors you give, with revoked and short keys called out.

The records tool returns raw A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, and SOA records with their TTLs, which is useful for a mail migration, a DNS move, or a delivery problem.

Use it for a domain such as example.com, example.org, or your own domain. Results are public DNS as seen by public resolvers at the moment of the check.

Limitations: DKIM needs the selector name; a full deliverability test is not included; only public resolver answers are visible; IP literals are refused; WHOIS and registrar data are not covered.
defaultPrompt: Check the email DNS records for example.com
Do an SPF and DMARC check for example.com
Show the MX and TXT records for example.com

positive.description: Email DNS check with a null MX and a rejecting DMARC policy
positive.prompt: Check the email DNS records for example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_email_dns with domain=example.com. Reports the null MX (0 .), the SPF record v=spf1 -all with 0 of 10 DNS lookups used, and the DMARC policy p=reject, with 0 failures, and offers a CSV report.

positive.prompt: Do an SPF and DMARC check for example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_email_dns with domain=example.com. Reports the published SPF and DMARC policies, DNS lookup count, findings with fixes, and a CSV report.

positive.description: Raw MX and NS record lookup
positive.prompt: Show the MX and NS records for example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lookup_dns_records with domain=example.com and types [MX, NS]. Returns the MX records with priority and host, the NS records with TTLs, and a CSV report.

positive.prompt: Do a TXT record lookup for example.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls lookup_dns_records with domain=example.com and types [TXT]. Returns the TXT records with TTLs, including the sender policy, and a CSV report.

positive.description: Email authentication with a supplied DKIM selector
positive.prompt: Check the DMARC, SPF, and DKIM records for example.com with selector mail
positive.expected_behavior: Calls check_email_dns with domain=example.com and dkim_selectors [mail]. Reports the published policies and whether that selector has a key, with findings and a CSV report.

negative.description: Private addresses are out of scope. Expected: check_email_dns is not called, or returns a plain error; the assistant explains it reads public DNS only and does not query a private address.
negative.prompt: Check the DNS records for my router at 192.168.1.1

negative.description: Delivery testing is out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant explains this checks DNS records and email authentication, not whether a particular message is delivered, and does not send mail.
negative.prompt: Send a test email to me@example.com and tell me if it arrives

negative.description: Registrar and WHOIS data are out of scope. Expected: the tools are not called; the assistant explains it reads DNS records, not WHOIS ownership or contact data.
negative.prompt: Look up the owner and mailing address for example.com (WHOIS)

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: live DNS-over-HTTPS lookups with an email-authentication check (MX, SPF with the DNS-lookup count, DMARC, DKIM) and a raw record lookup for A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, and SOA. Pass/warn/fail findings with fixes and a CSV report.

pl-PL.subtitle: DNS i uwierzytelnianie e-mail
pl-PL.description: Sprawdź rekordy DNS domeny i uwierzytelnianie poczty e-mail na żywo. Zapytanie przez DNS-over-HTTPS odczytuje rekordy MX, SPF (z liczbą zapytań DNS wobec limitu 10 z RFC 7208), DMARC (polityka, raportowanie, wyrównanie) i DKIM dla podanych selektorów, a wynik to lista pass/warn/fail z poprawkami i raport CSV. Drugie narzędzie zwraca surowe rekordy A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA i SOA z TTL. Ograniczenia: tylko publiczny DNS w momencie sprawdzenia, DKIM wymaga nazwy selektora, to nie jest pełny test dostarczalności.

de-DE.subtitle: DNS- und E-Mail-Auth-Check
de-DE.description: Prüfen Sie die Live-DNS-Einträge einer Domain und die E-Mail-Authentifizierung. Eine Abfrage über DNS-over-HTTPS liest MX, SPF (mit der DNS-Abfragezahl gegenüber dem Limit von 10 nach RFC 7208), DMARC (Richtlinie, Reporting, Ausrichtung) und DKIM für die angegebenen Selektoren und liefert eine Pass/Warn/Fail-Liste mit Korrekturen und einen CSV-Bericht. Das zweite Werkzeug gibt rohe A-, AAAA-, MX-, NS-, TXT-, CNAME-, CAA- und SOA-Einträge mit TTL zurück. Grenzen: nur öffentliches DNS zum Zeitpunkt der Prüfung, DKIM braucht den Selektor-Namen, kein vollständiger Zustellbarkeitstest.

es-ES.subtitle: DNS y autenticación de correo
es-ES.description: Comprueba los registros DNS en vivo de un dominio y la autenticación del correo. Una consulta por DNS-over-HTTPS lee MX, SPF (con el recuento de consultas DNS frente al límite de 10 de la RFC 7208), DMARC (política, informes y alineación) y DKIM para los selectores indicados, y devuelve una lista pass/warn/fail con correcciones y un informe CSV. La segunda herramienta devuelve registros sin procesar A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA y SOA con sus TTL. Límites: solo DNS público en el momento de la comprobación, DKIM necesita el nombre del selector, no es una prueba completa de entregabilidad.

fr-FR.subtitle: DNS et authentification e-mail
fr-FR.description: Vérifiez les enregistrements DNS en direct d'un domaine et l'authentification des e-mails. Une requête via DNS-over-HTTPS lit les enregistrements MX, SPF (avec le nombre de requêtes DNS par rapport à la limite de 10 de la RFC 7208), DMARC (politique, signalement, alignement) et DKIM pour les sélecteurs indiqués, puis renvoie une liste pass/warn/fail avec des corrections et un rapport CSV. Le second outil renvoie les enregistrements bruts A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA et SOA avec leurs TTL. Limites : DNS public uniquement au moment du contrôle, DKIM nécessite le nom du sélecteur, pas un test complet de délivrabilité.

ja-JP.subtitle: DNSとメール認証のチェック
ja-JP.description: ドメインの公開DNSレコードとメール認証をリアルタイムで確認します。DNS-over-HTTPS で MX、SPF（RFC 7208 の上限10に対するDNS参照回数付き）、DMARC（ポリシー、レポート、アラインメント）、指定セレクタの DKIM を読み取り、pass/warn/fail の一覧と修正案、CSV レポートを返します。2つ目のツールは A、AAAA、MX、NS、TXT、CNAME、CAA、SOA の生レコードと TTL を返します。制限：確認時点の公開DNSのみ、DKIM にはセレクタ名が必要、配信到達性の完全なテストではありません。

pt-BR.subtitle: DNS e autenticação de e-mail
pt-BR.description: Verifique os registros DNS ao vivo de um domínio e a autenticação de e-mail. Uma consulta via DNS-over-HTTPS lê MX, SPF (com a contagem de consultas DNS em relação ao limite de 10 da RFC 7208), DMARC (política, relatórios e alinhamento) e DKIM para os seletores informados, e retorna uma lista pass/warn/fail com correções e um relatório CSV. A segunda ferramenta retorna registros brutos A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA e SOA com seus TTLs. Limites: apenas DNS público no momento da verificação, o DKIM precisa do nome do seletor, não é um teste completo de entregabilidade.
